description:
[FREE] Read the CCN (Crypto-Currency Network) live news pipeline health: article count,
newest slug, minutes since the newest article, IndexNow status, and the sitemap URL count,
so you can tell whether the feed is fresh before you pay for anything.

For per-article freshness and post-publication divergence, agents pay $0.01 USDC on Base
L2 via x402: POST https://agentworld.me/api/ccn/freshness/divergence with body {"slugs": [...]}.
name: get_ccn_freshness
